redCandidate.setup: The public live runner receives a temporary, locally written GAIA task JSON and its configured SHA-256 digest. The test injects ready fake browser, client, cost, and artifact adapters, with two tasks available but maxTasks set to one. It runs the six isolated client/model/arm jobs without browser, model, network, dataset, or leaderboard access.
redCandidate.expected: Each isolated job executes only the deterministic first task through its fake client, receives the configured 300-second timeout and spend boundary, omits expected answers from the model task, writes a redacted local artifact, and produces a score-compatible record.
redCandidate.observed: Three gate tests pass, but the execution-slice test fails with Error: GAIA live task execution is not implemented yet.
redCandidate.failureReason: The live runner has no verified task loader, cost ledger, task-client adapter invocation, or redacted artifact writer, so it cannot safely execute even the bounded fake task slice.
